trigger: My family member has been arrested
description: What to do to help someone who has just been arrested.

steps.text: Stay calm. Find out which station they have been taken to.
Go to the station and ask, politely, why they are being held and on what grounds (s.35(3)).
Remind them, if you can, not to sign anything or answer questions without a lawyer (s.35(2)).
Ask whether they will be released on bail or charged to court. Police bail is free.
Note the officers' names, numbers, and the time of arrest.
Call a lawyer or Legal Aid to assist.
If they are held beyond the lawful time (s.35(4)), raise it with the lawyer.
